facet: Cradle Overrides (node system) and other global/account-wide combat-stat sources
gameVersionCovered: Cradle override texts: OHDB (oncehumandb.com) dataset mirrored on GitHub in 2026, containing v1.0 legacy, v1.4 (Jan 2025) general-pool, scenario-tag and unscaled datamine variants side by side; cross-checked against Sportskeeda v1.4 article, 2024-09-26 patch note and 2026-03 in-game hover captures (OHMM). Memetics: TKronix dataset through Prismverse's Clash. NOT verified against v2.3.5 (2026-03-25) or v3.0.6 (2026-09-16).

keyClaims.claim: A build may have at most 8 Cradle Overrides active (8 nodes); overrides are flat perks with no tiers, and equipped overrides can be swapped freely.
keyClaims.evidence: game8: 'There are a total of 8 cradle nodes available'; saitoh183 README: '8 compact icon-only cradle override slots'; OHMM cradleEffectResolver.ts: 'const cap = 8 … game enforces cap'; moabdrabou README: 'up to 8 Cradle Override items'; TheNerdStash/game8: swap by dragging another override onto the node.

keyClaims.claim: Node unlock differs by scenario: Manibus/Evolution's Call = 1 node at Cradle unlock + 1 per Monolith Great One defeated; Way of Winter = 1 node every 5 levels from Lv5, all 8 by Lv40.
keyClaims.evidence: game8 468460: 'You start with just one node … each boss you defeat will unlock you a single node'; game8 481150: 'Cradle Nodes unlock every 5 levels starting at Level 5, with all eight nodes available by Level 40.'

keyClaims.claim: Weapon-class overrides give DMG +20% while holding the class: Handgun Enhancement (pistols/shotguns), Automatic Weapon Enhancement (SMG/rifle/LMG), Long-Range Enhancement (sniper/crossbow), Melee Enhancement (melee); Anti-Coherence/Regen/Phase/Void give +15% DMG for their weapon groups plus +100% vs the matching Super Anomaly.
keyClaims.evidence: OHDB verbatim: 'DMG +20% when holding SMGs, rifles, or LMGs. Reload 10% of magazine capacity from reserve upon defeating an enemy.'; 'DMG +20% when holding sniper rifles or crossbows. 30% chance to automatically reload one bullet…'; 'When using rifles, shotguns, or heavy weapons, DMG +15%, with an additional 100% DMG against Super Anomaly - Void.' Same texts quoted by game8 and TheNerdStash snippets.

keyClaims.claim: Post-v1.4 (Jan 2025) general-pool conditional overrides: Tactical Combo = Weapon DMG +15% for 4s after swap/reload; Status Enhancement = Status DMG +15% for 3s after a weakspot hit; Elemental Sense = matching Element DMG +25% for 4s; Steady Hand = Weapon DMG +10% and Weakspot DMG +25% during Fortress Warfare/Fast Gunner; Marked Strike = Weakspot DMG +20% vs Bull's Eye targets; Critical Precision = Weakspot DMG +30% in scope.
keyClaims.evidence: OHDB rows tactical-combo-5017, status-enhancement-5018, elemental-sense-5013, steady-hand-5014, marked-strike, critical-precision; independently captured from in-game hover footage in OHMM cradleRegistry.ts ('Weapon DMG +15% for 4s after weapon swap or reload', 'Status DMG +15% for 3s after weakspot hit', 'Weapon DMG +10% and Weakspot DMG +25% while Fortress Warfare or Fast Gunner is active').

keyClaims.claim: The v1.4 rework nerfed/re-shaped several overrides; legacy values still circulate: Tactical Combo was +25% (now +15%), Status Enhancement +25% (now +15%), Steady Hand Weakspot +40% & +20% vs Bull's Eye (now +10%/+25%), Bounty Hunter was 'Weapon DMG +25%, Weakspot DMG +35% for 15s on killing a marked unit' and is now stacking (Attack +2%/stack ×5 on first mark, Weapon DMG +3%/stack ×5 on renew; alternative row: +5% Weapon DMG/stack ×6 for 8s on hitting a marked target).
keyClaims.evidence: OHDB keeps both rows (4010 vs 5017; unsuffixed vs 5018; 4016 vs 5014; bounty-hunter vs 5118/5108); Sportskeeda 1.4: 'Bounty Hunter - Attack +2% upon initially marking a target … up to 5 stacks'; OHMM 2026 capture agrees with the 5xxx texts.

keyClaims.claim: Stacking overrides for proc builds: Invincible Strike / Tracking Bullet = Shrapnel DMG +2.5% and Shrapnel Crit DMG +3.5% per weakspot hit, 10 stacks, 6s (Invincible Strike also -50% distance falloff at max); Transient Impact = Power Surge DMG +2.5% per Power Surge hit, 10 stacks, 6s; Overload = Power Surge DMG +2.5% per stack up to 10 until next reload; Extreme Freezing = Frost Vortex DMG +2.5% per stack ×10 (+3% slow, freeze at max); Bounce Rampage = Bounce DMG +5% ×5 for 15s; Explosives Bonus = Unstable Bomber DMG +5% ×5 for 8s; Heat Agglutination = Burn DMG +5% per Burn stack ×6 for 6s; Blazing Detonation = Burn DMG +25% for 10s; Prairie Fire Inferno = Blaze DMG +15% per burning unit up to +60%; Frost Sense = Frost DMG +3% ×12 for 8s.
keyClaims.evidence: OHDB verbatim rows invincible-strike-5113, tracking-bullet-5103, transient-impact-5117, overload, extreme-freezing, bounce-rampage-5104, explosives-bonus, heat-agglutination-5102, blazing-detonation, prairie-fire-inferno, frost-sense; OHMM registry mirrors Invincible Strike, Transient Impact, Extreme Freezing, Bounce Rampage, Explosives Bonus, Blazing Detonation with identical numbers.

keyClaims.claim: Sustained Suppression grants Continuous DMG +20% per stack (3 stacks, 10s) after killing with Burn/Frost Vortex; an official 2024-09-26 patch fixed it from an erroneous 15% per stack. A separate OHDB row (5007) reads 'Continuous DMG +25% for 4s after inflicting Continuous DMG', so the live text is unresolved.
keyClaims.evidence: punyjin news_09-26-24 (Thai translation of official notes): 'Fixed issue where Cradle perk Sustained Suppression only granted 15% per stack (should be 20%)'; OHDB rows sustained-suppression and sustained-suppression-5007.

keyClaims.claim: OHDB rows with sub-1% values (e.g. 'Precise Shot: Weapon DMG +0.2%', 'Elemental Surge +0.3%', 'Shrapnel DMG 7#+0.2%') are x100-unscaled datamine text, not live numbers; the same override appears elsewhere at full scale (Precise Shot: Weapon DMG +20%, Accuracy +30).
keyClaims.evidence: Paired OHDB rows precise-shot (Gunplay, +0.2%) vs precise-shot-3001 (Combat, +20%); speedy-shot vs speedy-shot-3002; robust vs robust-3003 (+25%/-30%); rifle-amplify (+0.01%) vs rifle-amplify-3004 (+1%); ice-blockade (+1%) vs ice-blockade-3019 (+60%); template garbage '7#' and '{2}s' in the same rows.

keyClaims.claim: Cradle percentages combine with gear through additive buckets that multiply each other: all 'Weapon DMG %' sources sum into one (1+x) factor, 'Status DMG %' into another, per-element 'Elemental DMG %' into another, keyword bonuses (Burn/Shrapnel/Power Surge DMG, additive with 'DMG Coefficient') into their own, and Crit DMG + Weakspot DMG are additive inside one hit-amplifier factor (weakspotCrit/body = 1 + critDMG + weakspotDMG). Status procs scale as PsiIntensity × coefficient × (1+StatusDMG) × (1+ElementDMG).
keyClaims.evidence: ADR-002: 'Once Human uses many separate additive pools, each of which becomes its own multiplicative factor … Crit DMG and Weakspot DMG are also additive within a single Hit Amplifier bucket'; Knowledge Bible: Factor and Coefficient 'are additive with each other within a single multiplicative bucket' (the 113 Test); OHCalc 05-validation-plan: 'weakspotCrit / body = 1 + critDamage + weakspotDamage'; OHCalc 03: burnTickDamage = psiIntensity × burnCoefficient × (1 + statusDamageBonus) × (1 + blazeElementalDamage).

keyClaims.claim: Memetic Specializations: one pick every 5 levels (Lv5–Lv50, 10 max) from 4 randomly rolled options, one per branch (Building, Crafting, Gathering, Management); two picks in a branch grant an Identity; Prismverse's Clash added Legendary Mayfly/Rosetta paths. They are almost entirely economy perks; the combat-relevant ones are Psi-scaled tactical items and Gene Coherence buffs (e.g. Extreme Gene: Weapon DMG +15% and Tactical Item DMG +15% below 30% HP; Judgment Coherence Injection: Status DMG +10% or Weapon DMG +10% at 10 Coherence; Lightning Impulse Regulator/Pulse Power Device: Psi Intensity +30% for 60s after a lightning strike) and food multipliers (Spicy Pepper dishes 30% more effective; Kitchen Set: Gourmand base dish effects +30%, duration +50%).
keyClaims.evidence: Fandom Memetics page (2024-09-18 scrape): 'Every 5 levels, a Memetic Specialization node will be unlocked, which offers a choice among 4 randomly generated Specializations'; Identities table; TKronix specializations.json verbatim effect texts.

keyClaims.claim: Eclipse Cortex, Deviation Securement Units and 'Mementos' are not combat-stat sources: Eclipse Cortex is purification material (Lv1/2/3 → 70/85/100 Starchrom), Securement environment only affects Deviant Mood/Power recovery, and 'Memento' is the R500 pistol. No gear-score/power-level damage formula exists; character level only gates gear tier (Lv30 → Tier IV, Lv40 → Tier V) and grants Memetic picks / Cradle nodes.
keyClaims.evidence: gamepressure: 'Eclipse Cortex lvl 1 yields 70 Starchroms … lvl 3 yields 100'; official Deviation wiki snippet: 'improve the rate of restoration for your Deviant's Mood and Deviant Power by designing a better Securement Environment'; fandom R500 - Memento page; Steam guide: 'Level 30 = Tier IV and below, Level 40 = Tier V and below … with regards to combat, it entirely depends on your gear and the perks you slot into cradle overrides'.
